Derived from šača- 'be born', cognate with Meadow Mari šočšo 'one's own children' .

A few different etymological explanations have been given for the Mari word. According to Bereczki (2013: 218–219) it's probable that Mari is a parallel loan from PII *Hárbha- 'small, weak, young' whence also Fi. orpana etc. According to Gordeev (1967: 195–196) the Mari word has been borrowed from the pre-form of Ossetic ærvad 'brother'. Both explanations are wanting and it's not readily obvious to me that Mari is necessarily connected to either of these proposed (Indo-)Iranian words. Proto-Mari *ĭrwećə.
